title: AI Will Happily Solve the Wrong Problem Very Efficiently
summary: The conversation delves into the power of storytelling in sales, emphasizing the importance of context, emotional response, and soft skills in the AI marketplace. It also explores the role of soft skills in business development and the relationship between process and context in sales.
keyQuote: In a market flooded with AI-generated outreach, storytelling is the last real differentiator.
guestBio: B2B sales consultant and author whose work centers on one idea: in a market flooded with AI-generated outreach, storytelling is the last real differentiator.
takeaways: Storytelling is a powerful tool in sales
Soft skills are crucial in the AI marketplace
